item.text: Wall Whitlowgrass (*Draba muralis*) is a flowering plant in the Brassicaceae family. Described by Linnaeus in 1753, it is native to mainland Portugal and Madeira. It is not protected under Portuguese or European Community legislation. [s1:p1–p2, s1:p4–p7]
